song.title: Don't Know What You Got (Till It's Gone)

guitar.evidence: Tom Keifer played various Les Pauls and B.C. Rich guitars; no single dominant iconic model widely documented.

tone.target: glossy 80s hard-rock lead with chorus sheen
tone.profile: glossy 80s hard-rock lead with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic 80s hard rock setup featuring a Boost for initial punch, Distortion for smooth gain, Chorus for sheen, followed by the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab, finished with Room reverb and Digital Delay.
corrections: replace generic crunch with polished lead

rig.name: Cinderella - Don't Know What You Got (Till It's Gone) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain leads and sustain.
Adding initial punch and bite for lead lines.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to keep the gain smooth and polished, matching 80s production style.

blocks.purpose: Providing smooth, controlled hard rock gain without fuzzy grind.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is the best fit for polished 80s lead tones compared to fuzz or RAT-style.

blocks.purpose: Creating the required 'chorus sheen' and wide stereo feel.
Simulating the classic Marshall/JCM style British hard rock tone.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 model captures the desired high-mid punch and aggressive clarity of 80s lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Providing the classic British hard rock cabinet sound.
blocks.gap: This cab model is ideal for achieving a polished, powerful 4x12 sound.

blocks.purpose: Brightening the tone and ensuring clarity for lead lines.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the high-end sparkle required for 80s polished leads.

blocks.purpose: Adding a subtle sense of space and polish to the lead tone.
blocks.gap: Room reverb provides a natural, non-metallic ambience suitable for polished rock leads.

blocks.purpose: Adding light echo and dimension without heavy tails.
blocks.gap: Kept the settings moderate to avoid 'heavy delay tails' as requested.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance 80s clarity and punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, polished high-end required for 80s lead tones.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the upper mids.
